name: medicine ball chest push multiple response
description: A kneeling medicine-ball chest pass with quick catches and immediate repeat throws, training repeated upper-body power.
instructions: Kneel upright facing a partner or a sturdy rebound wall and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your trunk and push the ball forward forcefully with both hands.
Catch the return close to your chest and immediately send the next pass without a long pause.
Keep your hips steady and repeat for the planned reps.
